### 2026-10-20: So adding the other components today:

**1.27h**

So adding the other components today:
the switches:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/542rCXKatZEHyJuWtRae38yR2HOj6oDb/2b16ea9482a80aaaa07056e71d580ef95dd5b20eb04c92ec758d41f0b95fd0ba.png)

Then the guide starts talking about adding more components than i have pins, and now I understand why there was the option to use the other micro controller. I thought about swapping it, but to be honest I'm not that bothered, so! Instead I'm keeping the switches I added, and then I did want to add some other stuff, like the rotary encoder and the sliding potentiometer, but they need more than one pin!!! Also apparently the  sliding potentiometer is a bit expensive, and I will definitely remember that for future projects. Since it only has 1 pin, I'm adding the LEDs.

On a side note, I feel like I'm enjoying this project a lot more as 1. I'm not rushing it at 2 AM for once, and 2. I'm starting to get what's going on and getting more comfortable with it? I know I can't stay comfortable for long and will have to attempt harder projects but pretty exciting!!

LEDS:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/542rCXKatZEHyJuWtRae38yR2HOj6oDb/173c0a89e6837f1bb1593bac2dc1c2e58c9c118131ec64a83cf333ee8cdf71b6.png)

I've also formated it nicely since I liked doing it on the first week, but also!! to solve my volume button problem, I'm just going to code the 3 switches to be lower volume, mute, raise volume.

Now I'm going to select the foot paths!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/542rCXKatZEHyJuWtRae38yR2HOj6oDb/b6535b95589bf50d0abbb15bb65b03b954d25b3815499b79f0404e7074e7d1f6.png)

I was pretty lucky that I had most of the components pre-assigned except the keys but the library that I downloaded for the guide must have been downloaded correctly because the Kailh Switches were there!!!

Anyways that's all for today, but pretty happy to be finished with the schematic (hopefully)!!
